# openwrt_dhcp_dnsmasq (Resource)

The dnsmasq DNS/DHCP server instance (`config dnsmasq`).

Manages a `dnsmasq` section in `/etc/config/dhcp`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `addnhosts` (List of String) Extra hosts files. (UCI option `addnhosts`.)
- `address` (List of String) Static answers `/domain/ip`. (UCI option `address`.)
- `allservers` (Boolean) Query all upstream servers. (UCI option `allservers`.)
- `authoritative` (Boolean) Authoritative DHCP server. (UCI option `authoritative`.)
- `boguspriv` (Boolean) Never forward reverse lookups for private ranges. (UCI option `boguspriv`.)
- `cachesize` (Number) DNS cache size. (UCI option `cachesize`.)
- `confdir` (String) Extra configuration directory. (UCI option `confdir`.)
- `dhcpleasemax` (Number) Maximum number of leases. (UCI option `dhcpleasemax`.)
- `dnssec` (Boolean) Validate DNSSEC. (UCI option `dnssec`.)
- `dnsseccheckunsigned` (Boolean) Check unsigned replies for DNSSEC. (UCI option `dnsseccheckunsigned`.)
- `domain` (String) Local DNS domain. (UCI option `domain`.)
- `domainneeded` (Boolean) Never forward plain names. (UCI option `domainneeded`.)
- `ednspacket_max` (Number) Maximum EDNS packet size. (UCI option `ednspacket_max`.)
- `expandhosts` (Boolean) Add the local domain to hostnames from hosts files. (UCI option `expandhosts`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `filter_a` (Boolean) Remove A records from answers. (UCI option `filter_a`.)
- `filter_aaaa` (Boolean) Remove AAAA records from answers. (UCI option `filter_aaaa`.)
- `filterwin2k` (Boolean) Filter useless Windows-originated queries. (UCI option `filterwin2k`.)
- `interface` (List of String) Listen only on these interfaces. (UCI option `interface`.)
- `ipset` (List of String) Populate ipsets `/domain/set`. (UCI option `ipset`.)
- `leasefile` (String) Lease file path. (UCI option `leasefile`.)
- `local` (String) Local-only domain, e.g. `/lan/`. (UCI option `local`.)
- `localise_queries` (Boolean) Answer with the address of the receiving interface. (UCI option `localise_queries`.)
- `localservice` (Boolean) Only answer queries from local subnets. (UCI option `localservice`.)
- `localuse` (Boolean) Use dnsmasq as the router's own resolver. (UCI option `localuse`.)
- `logqueries` (Boolean) Log DNS queries. (UCI option `logqueries`.)
- `nonegcache` (Boolean) Do not cache negative replies. (UCI option `nonegcache`.)
- `nonwildcard` (Boolean) Bind only to configured interfaces. (UCI option `nonwildcard`.)
- `noresolv` (Boolean) Do not read the resolv file. (UCI option `noresolv`.)
- `notinterface` (List of String) Never listen on these interfaces. (UCI option `notinterface`.)
- `port` (Number) DNS listen port (0 disables DNS). (UCI option `port`.)
- `quietdhcp` (Boolean) Suppress DHCP logging. (UCI option `quietdhcp`.)
- `readethers` (Boolean) Read /etc/ethers. (UCI option `readethers`.)
- `rebind_domain` (List of String) Domains allowed to return private addresses. (UCI option `rebind_domain`.)
- `rebind_localhost` (Boolean) Allow upstream 127.0.0.0/8 answers. (UCI option `rebind_localhost`.)
- `rebind_protection` (Boolean) Discard upstream RFC1918 answers. (UCI option `rebind_protection`.)
- `resolvfile` (String) Upstream resolv file. (UCI option `resolvfile`.)
- `sequential_ip` (Boolean) Allocate addresses sequentially. (UCI option `sequential_ip`.)
- `server` (List of String) Upstream servers (`/domain/ip` syntax supported). (UCI option `server`.)
- `strictorder` (Boolean) Query upstream servers in order. (UCI option `strictorder`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
